title.original: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents
title.zh: AgentSynth：通用计算机使用代理的可扩展任务生成
title.en: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentSynth 提供自动任务组合、难度控制、执行验证和轨迹采集流水线，可规模化服务通用计算机 Agent 数据生产。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentSynth provides automated task composition, difficulty control, execution verification, and trajectory collection for scalable computer-agent data production.

abstract.zh: AgentSynth 利用信息不对称自动合成长时程计算机任务和轨迹，把生成时简单的子任务组合成对 Agent 更具挑战且难度可控的任务。
abstract.en: AgentSynth exploits information asymmetry to synthesize long-horizon computer tasks and trajectories, composing generation-simple subtasks into agent-challenging tasks with controllable difficulty.

problem.zh: 通用计算机 Agent 的人工任务和轨迹昂贵，现有自动合成又难同时保证现实性、长时程难度和可调复杂度。
problem.en: Human-authored tasks and trajectories for general computer agents are expensive, while prior synthesis struggles to combine realism, long horizons, and controllable complexity.

approach.zh: 系统先生成可验证子任务，再按依赖关系组合为长任务，并通过改变子任务数量精确调节难度与采集对应执行轨迹。
approach.en: The system creates verifiable subtasks, composes them through dependencies into longer tasks, and controls difficulty by varying composition length while collecting execution trajectories.

system_design.zh: 流水线由子任务生成器、组合规划器、环境执行器、验证器和成本跟踪模块构成，输出带难度层级的任务—轨迹对。
system_design.en: The pipeline combines subtask generation, composition planning, environment execution, verification, and cost tracking to emit difficulty-graded task-trajectory pairs.

key_results.zh: 合成集能明显拉开先进 Agent 在不同组合深度上的表现，且轨迹成本远低于人工标注，证明其具有训练和评测扩展价值。
key_results.en: The generated suite sharply separates advanced agents across composition depths and produces trajectories far more cheaply than human annotation, supporting scalable training and evaluation.

limitations.zh: 任务真实性仍由生成器和基础环境决定；增加子任务数不等同于覆盖所有现实复杂性，轨迹质量也依赖执行与验证正确性。
limitations.en: Realism remains bounded by the generator and base environment; subtask count is not a complete proxy for real complexity, and trajectory quality depends on execution and verification.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
